description: This file contains utility functions for dynamically importing instances and modules, loading instances from remote storage (S3/GCS), and validating function return types. It is part of the proxy/utils submodule of the litellm project, handling dynamic module loading and remote resource fetching.

methods.name: Any get_instance_fn(value: str, config_file_path: Optional[str] = None)
methods.description: Dynamically imports and returns an instance or class from a specified module, supporting remote URLs (S3/GCS) and local modules, with optional config file path for custom module loading.

methods.name: Any _load_instance_from_remote_storage(remote_url: str, config_file_path: Optional[str] = None)
methods.description: Loads a Python module from remote storage (S3 or GCS), downloads the module, loads it into memory, and returns the specified instance.

methods.name: bool _download_gcs_file_wrapper(bucket_name: str, object_key: str, local_file_path: str)
methods.description: Asynchronous wrapper to download a file from GCS bucket.

methods.name: Optional[Callable[...,Literal[True]]] validate_custom_validate_return_type( fn: Optional[Callable[..., Any]], )
methods.description: Ensures that a given callable is annotated to return Literal[True], used for custom validation functions.
